paragraphs.en: Once upon a time, there was a magic garden behind the old castle.
paragraphs.cn: 从前，在古老的城堡后面有一个魔法花园。

paragraphs.en: In the garden, there were beautiful flowers that could sing and dance.
paragraphs.cn: 花园里有会唱歌跳舞的美丽花朵。

paragraphs.en: A little girl named Lily found the garden one sunny morning.
paragraphs.cn: 一个阳光明媚的早晨，一个叫莉莉的小女孩发现了这个花园。

paragraphs.en: She was very happy to see the magical flowers and talked to them every day.
paragraphs.cn: 她很高兴看到这些魔法花朵，每天都和它们说话。
